verdict.rationale: Recurly documents its own data import feature for populating accounts and records across an account, and exports of detailed reports across customers, subscriptions, invoices and more. That counts as bulk create and read handling of many records. Subscription changes and invoice edits are documented only per item, with no bulk update, cancel or modify operations shown. missing for 10: bulk modification or cancellation of many subscriptions/invoices at once, API-level batch endpoints, details on import scope and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Import customer data to populate accounts and records across your Recurly account.

how to bring data into your Recurly account and how to export detailed reports across your business — from customer records and subscriptions to invoices, coupons, transactions, and revenue recognition.
